content: व्यवधारणकल्पना {%f.%} A mode of interpreting a sentence where words or expressions connected with one another are treated as being not so connected, disconnecting what is connected; <ls>ŚB. on MS. 1. 2. 1</ls>; सैषा व्यवधारणकल्पना . तमस्मै भक्षं प्रयच्छेत् तमस्मै भक्षं कुर्यादित्यर्थः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 3. 5. 48</ls>.
